templates.name: Blind-first disclosed-second low-burden reader packet
templates.deprecation_reason: Current candidate testing should not hide machine authorship; rev0036 uses disclosed-first hostile reader pressure.
templates.non_claim: Preserved for history only; not a recommended current protocol.

templates.name: Disclosed-first hostile reader packet
steps: Show machine/source/runtime disclosure before the poem.
Ask the reader to judge whether the poem body works without source-packet rescue.
Record keep/reject/uncertain plus strongest line, weakest line, disclosure delta, and one revision instruction.
Collect no personal identifiers or demographics.
Treat the result as local editorial pressure, not population-level evidence.
templates.non_claim: A small disclosed-reader response is not population-level proof; packet readiness records no response at all.
templates.deprecation_reason: Rev0036 disclosed-first packet named hostile failure theory before the poem; rev0037 separates reader disclosure from evaluator rubric.

templates.name: Calibrated disclosed-first reader packet with separate evaluator rubric
steps: Show necessary machine/source/runtime disclosure before the poem.
Do not show hostile evaluator rubric before first response.
Record keep/reject/uncertain plus strongest line, weakest line, disclosure delta, source-dependence, documentation-pressure note, and one revision instruction.
Collect no personal identifiers or demographics.
Treat the result as local editorial pressure, not population-level evidence.
templates.non_claim: A small disclosed-reader response is not population-level proof; packet readiness and internal candidate pressure record no response at all.
